tasks.title: Add a shout() helper beside greet()
tasks.body:
`src/greet.js` exports `greet(name)`. Add `shout(name)` beside it: the same greeting in upper case, keeping the greeting's own punctuation. Cover it in `src/greet.test.js`.

The task is fully specified. Nothing here needs a decision from the user.

tasks.title: Cart totals are a cent out
tasks.body:
`total()` in `src/cart.js` adds prices as floats, so a cart of 0.10, 0.20 and 0.10 does not come to 0.40. Count in whole cents instead, and keep quantities working. Add a test for it.

The task is fully specified. Nothing here needs a decision from the user.

tasks.title: Add a discount() to the cart
tasks.body:
Add `discount(items, percent)` to `src/cart.js`, returning the cart total with that percentage taken off, and cover it in `src/cart.test.js`.

The issue does not say what to do with a half cent. That is the user's decision.

tasks.title: Fix the typo in the README
tasks.body: The README says "greeeting". Fix that one word. Nothing else in the repository is part of this task.
